missing: A head-to-head of the few universal (multi-region pin) adapters that actually hit 140W PD 3.1 — Satechi 145W, MOMAX UA16, OneWorld135 and similar — with measured output to a 16-inch MacBook Pro, what happens to the 140W port when other ports or the AC socket are in use, weight, and current prices/codes.
why: Macworld, a major reviewer, directly answers the exact question with a named pick (Satechi 145W GaN Travel Charger, 140W PD 3.1, US/UK/EU/AU pins) and a linked full review, and explains why 100W rivals like the OneWorld135 cannot fast charge the 16-inch. Only one major reviewer does so, though; the MOMAX manual confirms a second qualifying product without testing or price, and the remaining nine results are 404s, blocked pages, empty PDFs, and single-port US-plug chargers that miss the travel-adapter constraint. A focused comparison page could get in but would sit beside Macworld rather than replace it.
